name: IOI Properties Group Berhad
overview: IOI Properties Group Berhad 在2026年推进多项重大企业行动：完成以约38.4亿令吉收购新加坡 MVKIMI (BVI) Limited，并完成收购 Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd.；同时设立 IOIPG REIT 并将其酒店资产注入该产托，相关资产出售、发售及上市计划已获监管批准并进入执行阶段。
overview_en: In 2026, IOI Properties Group Berhad undertook several major corporate actions: it completed the acquisition of MVKIMI (BVI) Limited in Singapore for approximately RM3.84 billion and completed the acquisition of Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd.; it also established IOIPG REIT and injected its hotel assets into the REIT, with the related disposals, offering and listing proposals approved by regulators and moving into execution.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年完成两项新加坡资产收购，扩大产业发展及投资组合。
segments.note_en: Completed two Singapore asset acquisitions this year, expanding the property development and investment portfolio.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd.，购买代价为 SGD1.00（约 RM3.19），并偿还股东垫款 SGD217.32 million（约 RM693.07 million）。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd. for a purchase consideration of SGD1.00 (approximately RM3.19) and repaid shareholder's advances of SGD217.32 million (approximately RM693.07 million).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 MVKIMI (BVI) Limited，购买代价为 SGD1,196.704 million（约 RM3,844.771 million），并偿还股东贷款 SGD1,277.504 million（约 RM4,104.365 million）。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of MVKIMI (BVI) Limited for a purchase consideration of SGD1,196.704 million (approximately RM3,844.771 million) and repaid shareholder loans of SGD1,277.504 million (approximately RM4,104.365 million).

segments.name: 产业投资
segments.note: 今年推进 IOIPG REIT 设立及资产注入，涉及酒店资产出售、发售及上市。
segments.note_en: Progressed the establishment of IOIPG REIT and asset injection this year, involving the disposal of hotel assets, an offering and a listing.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent of the sale and purchase agreements under the REIT establishment, disposals, offering and listing proposals were fulfilled on 16 November 2026, and the agreements became unconditional.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 机构发售价及最终零售价定为每单位 RM0.91。
actions.text_en: The institutional price and final retail price were fixed at RM0.91 per unit.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: IOIPG REIT 招股书已于 2026 年 10 月 28 日向 SC 注册。
actions.text_en: The IOIPG REIT prospectus was registered with the SC on 28 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日批准 IOIPG REIT 上市，涉及 5,500,000,000 个单位，以及最多 300,000,000 个新单位作为管理费支付。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of IOIPG REIT on 30 September 2026, involving 5,500,000,000 units and up to 300,000,000 new units to be issued as payment of management fees.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: IOIPG REIT 于 2026 年 9 月 11 日设立，卖方于 2026 年 9 月 14 日与 MTrustee（代表 IOIPG REIT）就相关物业签订买卖协议。
actions.text_en: IOIPG REIT was established on 11 September 2026, and the vendors entered into sale and purchase agreements with MTrustee (acting on behalf of IOIPG REIT) on 14 September 2026 in relation to the subject properties.

segments.name: 酒店与休闲
segments.note: 今年将多家酒店资产注入 IOIPG REIT，并签订主租赁协议。
segments.note_en: Injected several hotel assets into IOIPG REIT this year and entered into master lease agreements.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 主租赁方 ICHSB、RVDSB 及 IBHSB 分别就 Le Meridien Putrajaya、Moxy Putrajaya、Putrajaya Marriott Hotel、Four Points by Sheraton Puchong、Courtyard by Marriott Penang 等酒店签订主租赁…
actions.text_en: Master lessees ICHSB, RVDSB and IBHSB entered into master lease agreements for hotels including Le Meridien Putrajaya, Moxy Putrajaya, Putrajaya Marriott Hotel, Four Points by Sheraton Puchong and Courtyard by Marriott Penang.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 设立 IOIPG REIT 并将酒店资产注入该产托，相关资产出售、发售及上市计划同步推进。
model_changes.text_en: Established IOIPG REIT and injected hotel assets into the REIT, alongside the related disposals, offering and listing proposals.
